description.value: Rumble Fish is a fresh seafood restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, branding itself as 'Sea to Street' with a menu of Pacific fish & chips, fish tacos, poke bowls, prawn rolls, and calamari. The kitchen emphasizes locally-sourced seasonal fish like sockeye salmon, Pacific cod, and halibut, prepared in a casual takeout-friendly format. The business also operates a GPS-tracked food truck, adding a mobile presence around the city.
